Existing ʕtbr I məʕtaballe/məʕtabər and ʕtrf I məʕtarafle/məʕtarəf provide the glossary convention for integrating t-containing Arabic bases. Thus I is preferable to inventing a Q analysis; final segmentation remains reviewable.

Only the first-person form (k) məʕtaqad-no is attested. The forms field explicitly leaves Preterit unattested and cites the observed Infectum base; no Preterit, Infinitiv or Detransitive is reconstructed.
